notes: Definition change, equivalent: the HTPoint field om_lat used Submodule.IsLattice C om, which on v4.36.0 (Mathlib #44365) names a weaker notion without span_eq_top. Here O is an arbitrary commutative ring, not one whose fraction field is C, so the target Submodule.IsFullLattice would add an independence hypothesis that the pinned field lacked. Following the merged M005740, the file defines a local class PinnedIsLattice with exactly the pinned fields (fg : M.FG and span_eq_top : span A M = ⊤), and om_lat now has type PinnedIsLattice C om, which is the pinned meaning. Downstream projections P.om_lat.fg and P.om_lat.span_eq_top keep their names and types. The IsLattice audit now reports 0 hits.
